I wrote the settings page to `solution.tsx`. I couldn't run or render it here, so it hasn't been tested.

- **Components:** the page is built from the kit components and uses only the brand variables for spacing and colour. It should follow whichever brand is active. I didn't write any CSS of my own.
- **Sections:** "Workspace settings" is the heading, with "General", "Notifications" and "Danger zone" as tabs. General shows first. I kept the General and Notifications panels mounted when hidden, so edits there survive switching tabs.
- **General:**
  - "Workspace name" is prefilled with "Orbit Lab".
  - "Default role for new members" is a radio group with Editor chosen.
  - "Save changes" is the primary button and shows "Settings saved." beside it. That status clears if you change the name
